purpose: Pre-migration performance contract. Prevent silent cost growth while keeping M0 behavior-equivalent.
principle: A migration/refactor may spend more performance budget only with explicit measured justification and device evidence.

asset_budgets.image_rule: Prefer responsive/compressed derivatives; do not add a full-resolution image to first-load path without measured reason.

renderer_budgets.background_expensive_work: zero or no-op while document hidden; embedded renderer should also pause/no-op while occluded
renderer_budgets.lazy_3d: No personal/world 3D before explicit user intent unless a measured lightweight stage is part of the chosen surface.
renderer_budgets.context_rule: Repeatedly mounted embedded renderers must dispose renderer/controls/resources and release context where safe.

frame_budgets.note: These are product budgets, not certification claims. Physical-device measurement is required.

world_complexity.caution: Legacy hall currently has documented scenes far above these targets. M0 preserves behavior; post-M0 culling/shared geometry/LOD work should close the gap rather than redefining the budget upward.

acceptance: No new first-load 3D dependency appears unintentionally.
No new always-running animation loop is introduced without hidden/occlusion lifecycle.
No renderer raises DPR or shadow cost without before/after evidence.
Any world complexity increase has measured phone evidence and a rollback path.
Physical-device acceptance remains separate from headless/browser evidence.
